modules.orphanRisk: Zero orphan risk directly in dashboard; metric values automatically recalculate and drop to ₹0.00 once underlying transaction collections are cleared.
modules.recalculationMechanism: Full automatic in-memory dynamic recalculation on view load (navigate('dashboard')) or via refresh button. Filtered by notVoided().
modules.preservationRequirements: Opening balance settings (settings.openingCash, openingBank, openingGeneralFund, etc.) must be verified and set to 0.00 (or ratified baseline).
modules.proposedCleanupAction: No direct document deletion in Dashboard. Underlying transactions are cleared in their respective primary stores; dashboard automatically refreshes to ₹0.00.

modules.evidenceSource: Source code review (fsCreateBillingWithAccounting, fsVoidLinkedBillingAndReceipt); PreStep22_5 backup (bill_3..5); STEP 22.5 report
linkedDependencies: billing/bill_{N} is bilaterally linked to receipts/rcpt_{N} sharing sequence N
accountingReceiptId points to receipts/rcpt_{N}
reservationDocId points to system/res_{N}
operationId points to system/op_{opId}
system/counters.globalSequenceCounter and billingReceiptCounter increment with each bill
thermal receipt reprint, devotee star history, and item sales frequency read billing store
modules.orphanRisk: Deleting billing/bill_{N} without deleting or voiding receipts/rcpt_{N} creates orphaned accounting receipts. Deleting receipt without billing creates orphaned bills and breaks thermal reprint.
modules.recalculationMechanism: switchBillingTab('active') and switchBillingTab('voided') query allBillingRecords() dynamically from Firestore/IndexedDB cache.
modules.preservationRequirements: Master pooja offerings in BILLING_DEFAULT_ITEMS (14 Malayalam pooja items) and sequence counters in system/counters must be preserved.
modules.proposedCleanupAction: Catalog all live billing IDs via authorized read-only inspection. Delete in synchronized batch with linked receipts, or mark voided. Sequence counters must NOT be decremented.

modules.evidenceSource: Source code review (fsCreateIndependentReceipt, fsVoidRecordSafe); PreStep22_5 backup (rcpt_1001..1005); STEP 22.5 report
linkedDependencies: Linked billing receipts point to billing/bill_{N} via billingFirestoreId and billingId
Independent receipts point to system/res_{N} and system/op_{opId}
Feeds directly into Cash Book (if paymentMode == 'Cash'), Bank Book (if Bank/UPI), General Ledger (credit), Trial Balance, Dashboard, Reports
Updates system/counters.globalSequenceCounter and receiptCounter
modules.orphanRisk: Deleting independent receipts without coordinating reservation records leaves reservations orphaned. Deleting billing-linked receipts breaks billing module links.
modules.recalculationMechanism: allReceipts() and activeReceipts() query receipts store. navigate('receipts') triggers fresh read and redraws register.
modules.preservationRequirements: Number reservation registry (system/res_*) and monotonic counters (system/counters) must be preserved to prevent reuse of numbers.
modules.proposedCleanupAction: Inventory actual live receipt documents. For test records, execute authorized deletion or retain voided state. Under candidate rules, deletion requires admin backend or console.

modules.evidenceSource: Source code review (VIEW_RENDERERS.payments, savePayment, allPayments); PreStep22_5 backup (0 docs)

fund references master funds collection (e.g. General Temple Fund)

modules.orphanRisk: Deletion removes debit entries from Cash Book, Bank Book, and Ledger; closing balances increase accordingly. If foreign keys to funds/categories exist, category charts must update cleanly.
modules.recalculationMechanism: allPayments() and activePayments() read payments store; balance reducers dynamically recalculate on view load.
modules.preservationRequirements: Master expense categories (64 items) and funds must be preserved. Voucher numbering continuity in system/counters must be preserved.
modules.proposedCleanupAction: Audit payments collection in live Firestore. If any test expense vouchers exist, execute authorized deletion. Verify Cash Book and Bank Book recalculate to exact expected figures.

Opening balance loaded from settings.openingCash
Chronological sorting by date with running balance accumulation
modules.orphanRisk: No primary documents stored under 'cashbook'. Inconsistent deletion of paired contra transfers or voided items would cause running balance jumps.

modules.preservationRequirements: settings.openingCash must be set to 0.00 (or approved baseline starting cash).
modules.proposedCleanupAction: No documents to delete in cashbook. Cleanup of primary transaction stores automatically resets Cash Book to opening balance.

linkedDependencies: buildBankBookRows merges receipts (Bank/UPI), payments (Bank/UPI), loans (Bank/UPI), chitty collections/payouts (Bank/UPI), and transfers (fromAcc/toAcc == 'Bank')

Chronological sorting by date with running balance accumulation
modules.orphanRisk: No primary documents stored under 'bankbook'. Partial deletion of transfers causes asymmetric balance corruption.
modules.recalculationMechanism: Fully dynamic in buildBankBookRows(). updateBankBookTotals() dynamically sums visible deposits and withdrawals.
modules.preservationRequirements: settings.openingBank must be set to 0.00 (or verified bank passbook opening balance).
modules.proposedCleanupAction: No documents to delete in bankbook. Cleanup of primary transaction stores automatically resets Bank Book to opening balance.

modules.proposedCleanupAction: No documents to delete in ledger. Once receipts and payments are cleared, ledger table displays zero rows and ₹0.00 totals.

protectedMetadata.rationale: Singleton high-water sequence marks (globalSequenceCounter, billingReceiptCounter, receiptCounter, voucherCounter). Resetting or decrementing causes duplicate receipt numbers and violates candidate Firestore rules.
protectedMetadata.preservationPolicy: MANDATORY PRESERVATION. Never decrement or reset to 0. If starting fresh sequence is desired, committee must establish a higher starting mark (e.g., 10000).

protectedMetadata.rationale: Atomic reservation records preventing allocation gaps and race conditions. Candidate rules prohibit physical deletion (allow delete: if false;).
protectedMetadata.preservationPolicy: MANDATORY PRESERVATION. Existing reservations must be retained as tombstoned/voided audit markers. Never delete.

protectedMetadata.rationale: Write-once cryptographic fingerprints preventing transaction replay and double-posting. Candidate rules strictly forbid update and delete.
protectedMetadata.preservationPolicy: MANDATORY PRESERVATION. Committed operation tokens are permanent audit records.

protectedMetadata.rationale: Disaster recovery session state gating isRestoreSessionActive() in candidate rules.
protectedMetadata.preservationPolicy: Retain completed progress marker; do not delete physically.

protectedMetadata.preservationPolicy: MANDATORY PRESERVATION. Only opening balance fields (openingCash, openingBank, etc.) are reset to verified zero baseline.

cleanupPhases.name: Obtain Authorized Production Backup
cleanupPhases.description: Execute native application downloadBackup() under authorized admin session in temple-f4f7d. Optionally execute gcloud firestore export.

cleanupPhases.name: Verify Backup Integrity and Document Counts
cleanupPhases.description: Verify RFC 8785 canonical SHA-256 integrity checksum, document counts across all 13 collections, system/counters, system/res_*, and system/op_*.

cleanupPhases.name: Inventory Actual Production Transaction IDs
cleanupPhases.description: Execute read-only inspection via Firebase Console or authorized query script to record exact document IDs, devotee names, dates, amounts, and linkages.

cleanupPhases.name: Produce Surgical Deletion Manifest
cleanupPhases.description: Generate machine-readable deletion manifest specifying exact document paths, deletion reasons, linked dependencies, and verification criteria.

cleanupPhases.name: Review Manifest and Obtain Trustee Authorization
cleanupPhases.description: Present manifest and verification findings to Temple Trustees for written sign-off before any mutation is permitted.

cleanupPhases.name: Execute Cleanup via Controlled Mechanism
cleanupPhases.description: Execute authorized deletion via Firebase Console or Admin SDK (since candidate client rules prohibit client deletion). Preserve counters and reservations.

cleanupPhases.name: Verify Multi-Module Consistency
cleanupPhases.description: Verify all 13 collections, billing, receipts, payments, transfers, chitty, loans contain zero dangling records or orphaned links.

cleanupPhases.name: Recalculate and Validate Financial Summaries
cleanupPhases.description: Verify Dashboard liquid position, Cash Book, Bank Book, General Ledger, and Trial Balance reflect exact zero (or approved opening baseline).

cleanupPhases.name: Confirm Protected Data Integrity
cleanupPhases.description: Verify temple settings, 6 funds, categories, bank account, sequence counters, and reservations remain completely intact.

cleanupPhases.name: Verify Clean Launch State on Production Bundle
cleanupPhases.description: Clear client browser cache, perform cold-start login, verify flawless UI appearance with zero dummy data and zero console errors.
